# @fyit/crouton-charts

> Chart visualizations powered by nuxt-charts, connected to collections

AI hint: use when app needs data visualization, graphs, charts, analytics dashboards

## Components

- `CroutonChartsBlocksChartBlockRender`: Read-only public renderer for a chart editor block
- `CroutonChartsBlocksChartBlockView`: Editor node view for a chart block
- `CroutonChartsWidget`: Collection-driven chart component (bar, line, area, donut)

Props, events and slots: [components.md](components.md)

## Composables

- `useCollectionChart`
